name: assetpanda/page-toc
title: AP Page Toc
description: Floating 'On this page' panel for long articles: a pill at the left edge that opens a card listing the page's sections, the section in view highlighted, with a reading-progress bar; closes from its X. Shown from 1200px up (the margin beside the article column). Figma: Website Design 2026 > Floating TOC Panel (7224:2). This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
